title: Bivariate meta-analysis of diagnostic test accuracy in the browser: a tool validated against the R package mada
description: The allmeta DTA SROC app (validated at allmeta commit 76d3e9d) and a one-command validation against the R package mada on all six diagnostic-accuracy datasets bundled with mada. The app fits the bivariate random-effects model (Reitsma) by REML, ML, method of moments, variance components or fixed effect, with mada's three continuity-correction rules and optional meta-regression, and reports summary sensitivity and specificity, likelihood ratios, Rutter-Gatsonis parameters, the SROC curve, AUC and partial AUC, and 95% confidence and prediction regions. Across 105 method, correction and covariate configurations on 6 datasets (159 two-by-two tables), the app agrees with mada on all 105: 80 fits within numerical tolerance and the same 25 refusals; 855/855 checks pass. Includes the corpus builder, R reference fits, the engine runner, the analysis that regenerates the article's tables, figures and statistics with a PASS/FAIL check of every number, a Docker image (canonical environment: R 4.6.0, mada 0.5.12, Node 24.15.0) and CI on Linux, Windows, macOS and Docker. Earlier app versions had known issues, fixed in allmeta PR #77 (see CHANGELOG.md).
